name: clickflash-ecosystem
description: ClickFlash Photography Ecosystem - 6 apps for professional photographers

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:master" "npm run dev:touch" "npm run dev:management" "npm run dev:gallery" "npm run dev:website" --names "master,touch,management,gallery,website" --prefix-colors "blue,green,purple,pink,cyan"
scripts.install:apps: cd apps/master && npm install && cd ../touch && npm install && cd ../management && npm install && cd ../gallery && npm install && cd ../website && npm install && cd ../moneytrash && npm install
scripts.build:all: npm run build:master && npm run build:touch && npm run build:management && npm run build:gallery && npm run build:website
scripts.build:master: cd apps/master && npm run build && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:touch: cd apps/touch && npm run build && npm run build:backend
scripts.test:all: npm run test:master && npm run test:touch && npm run test:management && npm run test:gallery && npm run test:website && npm run test:moneytrash
scripts.test:ecosystem: cd apps/master && npm test && cd ../management && npm test && cd ../gallery && npm test && cd ../touch && npm test
scripts.test:ecosystem:coverage: cd apps/master && npm run test:coverage && cd ../management && npm run test:coverage && cd ../gallery && npm run test:coverage && cd ../touch && npm run test:coverage
scripts.test:ecosystem:ci: cd apps/master && npm run test:ci && cd ../management && npm run test:ci && cd ../gallery && npm run test:ci && cd ../touch && npm run test:ci
scripts.test:e2e: npx tsx tests/ecosystem/reset.ts && npx playwright test --config=playwright.ecosystem.config.ts
scripts.lint:all: cd apps/master && npm run lint && cd ../touch && npm run lint && cd ../management && npm run lint && cd ../gallery && npm run lint && cd ../website && npm run lint && cd ../moneytrash && npm install
scripts.typecheck:all: cd apps/master && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../touch && npm run typecheck && cd ../management && npm run typecheck && cd ../gallery && npm run typecheck && cd ../website && npm run typecheck && cd ../moneytrash && npm run typecheck
